{{Short description|Genetic model for twin studies}}
An '''ADE model''' is a genetic model for [[twin studies]] which includes [[Dominance (genetics)|dominance]] genetic effects.<ref>{{cite journal |author=Locatelli I |title= The heritability of breast cancer: a Bayesian correlated frailty model applied to Swedish twins data |journal=Twin Research |volume=7 |issue=2 |pages=182–191 |year=2004 |pmid=15169603 |doi=10.1375/136905204323016168 |display-authors=etal|doi-access=free }}</ref>

''A'' stands for [[additive genetic effects|''additive'' genetic effects]], ''D'' for non-additive genetic (or [[dominance (genetics)|''dominance'']]) effects, and ''E'' for nonshared ''environment'' effects.<ref>Douglas A. Raynor ''et al''. (2002). "Covariation of Psychosocial Characteristics Associated With Cardiovascular Disease: Genetic and Environmental Influences".</ref>
